events.title: Devlog #07: Third Rail
events.summary: Below the streets of Sin City there is a metro line nobody rides anymore. The lights still burn. The trains still run. Nobody knows who is driving them.For the full game, we are building a sequence down there, and we cannot wait to show you where it is heading.Two tracks, two trainsVictor drops into the tunnel with one goal: reach the control room at the far end and shut the line down. events.title: Devlog #06: Roadkill
events.summary: You told us one thing louder than anything else after the demo: you love the car.Victor's old Impala was never meant to be the star. It was a way to get from the street to the warehouse, a quiet place to breathe between nightmares. Then you started drifting it around the corners of Sin City just for fun, and we started asking ourselves a dangerous question What if the car could fight back?The Impala is a weapon nowIn the full game, the road is no longer safe and empty. events.title: Devlog #04: Welcome to Sin City
events.summary: Every story needs a city, and ours is Sin City. Four brutal murders in a few weeks. Then a seven year old girl, Klara Jenkins, taken from her own bed. By the time the demo begins, half the police force is out on the streets, and none of them know what they're looking for.Victor does. And he's driving. events.title: Devlog #03: Loose Ends
events.summary: For two devlogs we've talked about the things Victor is chasing. This time we want to talk about Victor himself: where he comes from, and the small details we've been fussing over so that he moves like that man and nobody else. A medium and a cop His mother was a medium. The phone rang at strange hours, strangers sat in the living room holding hands, and she talked to people who weren't there. events.title: Devlog #02 — The Evidence Room
events.summary: Every detective needs a place to think. In Deceptive Shadows, that place is the Evidence Room: a cramped office with a corkboard, a desk and a bookshelf full of things nobody should have to read. After the graveyard chapter, Victor comes back here with his pockets full, and this is where the case starts to make sense. Or stops making sense. events.title: Devlog #01 — The Passengers
events.summary: Welcome to the first devlog for Deceptive Shadows! From now on we'll post two of these a week, going behind the scenes on whatever we've been building. This first one is about the ending of our demo chapter, the Metro. It's the scene we're proudest of, and it's also the hardest one to show without spoiling it. 💡 The ideaIn most horror games, you know an enemy when you see one.
